rules.intro: Automate your printer with safe IF-THEN rules. Off by default; arm each rule yourself.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Add one below, then arm it when you're ready.

engine.masterNote: Nothing runs until both the engine and the individual rule are on.

overview.title: What is the rules engine?
overview.body: It watches the printer and runs an action when a condition you set is met - for example, log a note when a print finishes, or turn the heaters off. Each rule is IF (a trigger) THEN (an action).

safety.title: How it stays safe
safety.body: The engine is off by default and every rule must be armed individually, so nothing runs by surprise. A rule fires once when its condition first becomes true. G-code actions only run while the printer is idle - they are refused during a print - and every outcome is logged.

trigger.def: The condition that starts a rule, e.g. a print finishing or a heater crossing a temperature.

action.def: What the rule does when it fires: log a notification, or run a g-code command (only while idle).

armed.def: A rule that is switched on. Disarmed rules are kept but never fire.
